summary: Starfighters Space, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 5,223,879 common shares at $3.35/share for gross proceeds of $17.5 million. Cantor Fitzgerald acted as exclusive placement agent. The transaction is a standard equity financing, not a special situation. The filing covers entry into a securities purchase agreement, lock-up agreements with officers/directors, and restrictions on future issuance for 60 days. Proceeds will support operational expansion and STARLAUNCH platform development. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation catalyst is present; this is a routine capital-raising event.
